name: Restore text-cursor blink to the Windows default

steps.note: let the console open (its blinking cursor never lets the screen go still)

steps.text: powershell -NoProfile -Command "(Add-Type -Name Caret -Namespace RdpAgent -PassThru -MemberDefinition '[DllImport(\"user32.dll\")] public static extern bool SetCaretBlinkTime(uint ms);')::SetCaretBlinkTime(530)" & exit
steps.note: set the blink rate, then close the console
